# fetchloom

fetchloom is uv for research data on windows and linux, on x86_64 and arm64. `data.toml` is the shopping list, `data.lock` is the receipt pinning files by SHA-256 and size, and the shared cache is the pantry. `fetchloom sync` fills `data/` by reflink, hardlink or copy.

## using fetchloom

- [front page](README.md): install and quick start
- [user guide](docs/user/README.md): every user page and when to read it
- [getting started](docs/user/getting-started.md): source installation, first project and files to share
- [concepts](docs/user/concepts.md): manifest, lock, cache, placement, archives and offline preparation
- [commands](docs/user/commands/README.md): command table, global options and terminal output
- [add](docs/user/commands/add.md): add and pin a dataset
- [sync](docs/user/commands/sync.md): restore pins while preserving local edits
- [lock](docs/user/commands/lock.md): check or upgrade pins without placement
- [list](docs/user/commands/list.md): dataset references, locked sizes and folders
- [search](docs/user/commands/search.md): concurrent public catalog search and explicit selection
- [status](docs/user/commands/status.md): local differences and success-with-differences behavior
- [path](docs/user/commands/path.md): absolute paths and implicit sync
- [remove](docs/user/commands/remove.md): remove entries and unchanged managed files
- [get](docs/user/commands/get.md): one-off downloads and existing-folder rules
- [cache](docs/user/commands/cache.md): inspection, garbage collection and verification
- [sources](docs/user/sources/README.md): reference spellings, pins, credentials and limits for each family
- [data.toml](docs/user/reference/data-toml.md): manifest keys, path rules and patterns
- [data.lock](docs/user/reference/data-lock.md): lock fields, source records and hash encodings
- [JSON output](docs/user/reference/json-output.md): schema, command results, partial cache failures and work counters
- [exit codes](docs/user/reference/exit-codes.md): stable error kinds and recovery decisions
- [environment](docs/user/reference/environment.md): runtime settings, credentials and color behavior
- [cache folder](docs/user/reference/cache-folder.md): shared cache layout and indexes
- [project folder](docs/user/reference/project-folder.md): owner records and placement state
- [scripting](docs/user/scripting.md): JSON recipes, conflict checks and the python helper
- [windows](docs/user/windows.md): Defender, dev drives, aliases, synced folders and long paths
- [troubleshooting](docs/user/troubleshooting.md): recorded errors, causes and fixes
- [limits](docs/user/limits.md): excluded workflows and reproducibility boundaries
